description: Integrate all uptime-hub source code into the workspace. Copy pages (renamed with Op prefix) to src/pages/operations/, copy shared components to src/components/operations/, copy lib utilities, copy all 8 edge functions to supabase/functions/, copy drizzle/ directory. Create the merged ops-schema SQL migration. This feature is independent of FEAT-003 (route/auth rewrites) but depends on FEAT-001 (workspace scaffolded).
steps: 1. Create directory src/pages/operations/. Copy from .agents/temp/uptime-hub/src/pages/ with renames: Dashboard.tsx→OpDashboard.tsx, VendorIssues.tsx→OpVendorIssues.tsx, VendorUptime.tsx→OpVendorUptime.tsx, Incidents.tsx→OpIncidents.tsx, Passwords.tsx→OpPasswords.tsx, Documents.tsx→OpDocuments.tsx, Analytics.tsx→OpAnalytics.tsx, SmsLogs.tsx→OpSmsLogs.tsx, Escalations.tsx→OpEscalations.tsx, UserManagement.tsx→OpUserManagement.tsx, ForcePasswordChange.tsx→OpForcePasswordChange.tsx. Do NOT copy Auth.tsx, Index.tsx, NotFound.tsx.

2. Create directory src/components/operations/. Copy from .agents/temp/uptime-hub/src/components/ (top-level only, not ui/): StatsCard.tsx→StatsCard.tsx, ExportMenu.tsx→ExportMenu.tsx, PageHeader.tsx→PageHeader.tsx, ChunkErrorBoundary.tsx→ChunkErrorBoundary.tsx, VendorPicker.tsx→VendorPicker.tsx, NotificationBell.tsx→OpNotificationBell.tsx.

3. Create directory src/hooks/operations/. Copy .agents/temp/uptime-hub/src/hooks/useUserRole.ts → src/hooks/operations/useUserRole.ts (kept as reference; the canonical hook is at src/hooks/useUserRole.ts created in FEAT-003).
4. Copy .agents/temp/uptime-hub/src/lib/exportUtils.ts → src/lib/exportUtils.ts (ums-docs-vault has export-utils.ts; keep both).

6. Copy edge function directories from .agents/temp/uptime-hub/supabase/functions/ to supabase/functions/: notify-sms/, password-reminders/, escalations/, admin-create-user/, admin-reset-password/, admin-update-email/, complete-password-change/. Copy send-sms/ as ops-send-sms/ (rename to avoid conflict with ums-docs-vault's send-sms/).
7. Copy .agents/temp/uptime-hub/drizzle/ directory to drizzle/ in workspace root (tooling reference).

8. Update supabase/config.toml: add JWT override entries for the 5 new uptime-hub functions that need verify_jwt=false: ops-send-sms, password-reminders, admin-create-user, notify-sms, admin-update-email. The config.toml already has the ums-docs-vault entries from FEAT-001. Full merged content in plan.md step 5.

9. Create supabase/migrations/20261015000000_ops_schema.sql with the full SQL from plan.md step 12. This migration: extends app_role enum with 'manager' and 'user' values; adds columns to profiles (title, department, phone_number, avatar_url) with IF NOT EXISTS; creates incidents, vendor_issues, passwords, password_renewals, escalation_levels, escalations, escalation_events, ops_notifications tables with full RLS policies; enables pg_cron and pg_net extensions.

10. Update all import paths in the 11 ops page files and 6 ops component files. Apply the import rewrite table from plan.md step 15: change @/components/StatsCard → @/components/operations/StatsCard, @/components/PageHeader → @/components/operations/PageHeader, @/components/ExportMenu → @/components/operations/ExportMenu, @/components/NotificationBell → @/components/operations/OpNotificationBell, @/components/VendorPicker → @/components/operations/VendorPicker, @/components/ChunkErrorBoundary → @/components/operations/ChunkErrorBoundary.
11. In OpNotificationBell.tsx: change the Supabase table query from 'notifications' to 'ops_notifications'.

12. In OpDocuments.tsx: update the Supabase select query to use columns that exist in the ums-docs-vault documents schema. Change .select('id, name, file_path, file_size, file_type, uploaded_by, created_at') to .select('id, title, file_path, file_type, uploaded_by, created_at') and display 'title' where 'name' was displayed.
13. In all ops pages and components: if @/components/AppLayout is imported, change to @/components/layout/AppLayout. Remove any standalone AppSidebar imports (sidebar is embedded in AppLayout).

14. In all ops pages that reference useUserRole for role checks: ensure they import from @/hooks/useUserRole (the unified hook created in FEAT-003). Since FEAT-003 runs after FEAT-002, leave the import as @/hooks/useUserRole — FEAT-003 will create that file.
15. Replace old Supabase project IDs in any ops edge function files: search for 'bcrzhajeiybglhwfrqye' (uptime-hub's old project) and replace with 'mmnpopwzfjyfasvzzatg'.

16. In supabase/migrations/20261014120000_auto_escalation_cron.sql (copied from uptime-hub via step 1 of FEAT-001, as this file is in the uptime-hub migrations folder): this file is NOT copied as part of FEAT-001 (it's an uptime-hub migration). Copy it now from .agents/temp/uptime-hub/supabase/migrations/20261014120000_auto_escalation_cron.sql to supabase/migrations/20261014120000_auto_escalation_cron.sql. Then replace the <PROJECT_REF> placeholder with 'mmnpopwzfjyfasvzzatg'. Leave <SERVICE_ROLE_KEY> as a placeholder — it requires a Supabase secret not storable in source.
acceptance_criteria: src/pages/operations/ contains exactly 11 .tsx files (OpDashboard through OpForcePasswordChange)
supabase/functions/ has 13 subdirectories total (5 from ums-docs-vault + 8 from uptime-hub)
supabase/migrations/20261015000000_ops_schema.sql exists and contains CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.incidents
npm run build exits with code 0 (type errors in ops pages are acceptable only if they concern types not yet defined in types.ts — fixed in FEAT-004)
